{07 14 00}It's nice to see that your
house is getting a little
bigger, {04 1f 00}.

I'm sure you're a lot
happier with it, aren't you?

läheb natuke
suuremaks, {04 1f 00}.
{07 0b 00}Kuidas see sulle meeldib?{01 00 00 14 00}
Oled kindlasti palju

messages.en:
{07 1a 00}I noticed you had a second
story built on your house,
{04 1f 00}! Nice work!
{07 14 00}It's great having a second
floor. It opens up so many
design possibilities!
{07 0d 00}You can go modern on the
ground floor and rococo
upstairs, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 1a 00}Ma nägin, et sulle ehitati
majale teine korrus,
{04 1f 00}! Tubli töö!
{07 14 00}Teine korrus on vahva.
See avab nii palju
kujundusvõimalusi!
{07 0d 00}Sa võid minna moodsaks
alumisel korrusel, rokokoo
ülal, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 1a 00}Congratulations on getting
such a huge house,
{04 1f 00}!
{07 14 00}More house means more
room for furniture, just
for starters, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}It may seem like work,
{07 0b 00}deciding which furniture
goes where, though, huh?
{07 04 00}Of course, there's no
reason you need to go
crazy with furniture...
{07 14 00}Just enjoy all the open
space, and see if you like
the minimalist approach.
messages.et:
{07 1a 00}Palju õnne nii tohutu maja
puhul,
{04 1f 00}!
{07 14 00}Rohkem maja tähendab
rohkem ruumi mööblile,
alustuseks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}See võib tunduda tööna,
{07 0b 00}otsustada, milline mööbel
kuhu läheb, kas pole?
{07 04 00}Muidugi pole põhjust
mööbliga hulluks
minna...
{07 14 00}Naudi lihtsalt avarat ruumi
ja vaata, kas sulle meeldib
minimalistlik lähenemine.

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, you haven't
remodeled your house even

{07 0b 00}Don't you want a bigger

{07 00 00}Personally, I couldn't
stand living in such a

{07 0b 00}Are you afraid of

{07 06 00}That'd be terrible! What if

{04 15 00}?

wouldn't it?{01 00 00 05 00} Sheesh!

kui sa kaotaksid oma kalli
{04 15 00}?

{04 1f 00}? {07 0b 00}How did you

{07 00 00}"It's all right"? {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}What kind

{07 16 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, you're not the

messages.en:
{07 1a 00}Wow, {04 1f 00}! That's

{07 0d 00}It never hurts to have
